zh: 识别串：连接开头明文交换的版本与软件说明行。
1.x：没有正式标准化文本的旧 SSH 协议线。
1.99：双支持服务器用来表明兼容的版本串。
ssh-1.2.30：旧协议唯一的非正式材料来源。
回退重连：发现对端是旧协议时的处置。
en: Identification string: the cleartext version and software line sent first.
protoversion: the version field inside that string.
1.x: the older SSH line with no standardised text.
1.99: the version string a dual-supporting server announces.
ssh-1.2.30: the only informal source for the old protocol.
Fall back and reconnect: the handling when the peer turns out to be old.
